lore.text: After Superman was seemingly killed fighting Doomsday, Project Cadmus tried to create a clone to replace him. The clone had only been aged to his teens when he broke out. He believed he was created from Kryptonian DNA, though not Superman's. His powers were different, using Tactile Telekinesis (mental control over things he touched) to mimic things like flight and super-strength. Trying to fill the void left by Superman, he was initially rash and impulsive, but his intentions were good, and he worked hard, quickly becoming a valued hero to Metropolis. Responding to the destruction of Coast City, he was tricked and defeated by the Cyborg Superman, but the return of the real Superman saved the day. With its champion returned, Superboy felt Metropolis no longer needed him and moved to Hawaii.

Superboy spent some time as the hero of Hawaii, where he dated a young reporter named Tana Moon. However, Superboy was infected by a genetic virus that started breaking down his cells and, though he was cured, doctors told him he was left in a state where he might not age normally. Uncomfortable with this and Superboy's youthful impulsivity, including flirting with other girls, Tana broke up with him. Superman invited Superboy to the Fortress of Solitude and showed him Krypton through virtual reality. He said he considered Superboy part of the family and offered him the Kryptonian name Kon-El. Deeply moved, Superboy accepted, using the name Conner Kent when staying at the Kent Farm or using a civilian identity. Superboy also became a member of Young Justice, a team of youthful heroes.

After Young Justice disbanded, Superboy joined the Teen Titans. Robin discovered that Conner's DNA contained Superman's genes but also a human's, and the source was Lex Luthor. Ashamed of this, Conner asked Robin to keep it a secret. After some time with the Titans, he decided to tell them the truth, but before he could, Luthor activated a code he had implanted in Superboy that caused him to turn against his friends. Superboy was ultimately able to break free, but the guilt he felt over what had happened made him quit the team and retreat to the Kent Farm for a long period of time. When the deranged Superboy Prime came from another Earth bent on creating a new Multiverse, Conner sacrificed his life to stop him. He was buried in Metropolis under a statue honoring his sacrifice.

Conner was revived in the 30th Century by Brainiac-5 of the Legion of Super Heroes, using similar technology to that which once revived Superman. Conner helped the Legion defeat Superboy Prime and the Legion of Super-Villains, then returned to his time. He lived on the Kent Farm and rejoined the Teen Titans, where he reconnected with his former girlfriend, Wonder Girl (Cassie Sandsmark). She confessed she'd recently been involved with Robin (Tim Drake). Conner understood; after all, she'd believed him dead. But as he spent more time immersing himself in his Kryptonian heritage, they drifted apart and split. Later, Conner was pulled into the mystic Gemworld dimension. Other members of Young Justice followed, but after defeating the evil Lord Opal, they realized they were lost in the Multiverse.

Finally returning to his home dimension, Conner discovered that Amanda Waller had created a clone of him who believed he was the real thing and made him a member of the Suicide Squad. The two fought, and the clone, whom Conner called "Match", began to show signs of a genetic illness, with his skin turning white. Conner defeated him and tried to help him, but Waller teleported him away. Later, Conner helped the Superman Family battle the villain Conduit, but now that Jonathan Kent, the son of Superman and Lois who had rapidly aged to his teens, was present, the experience left him feeling out of place. Conner decided to spend some time in the far reaches of space in order to discover who he is in places where no one has heard of Superman.

Returning to Earth, Conner was welcomed by Superman and the rest of the Superman Family. Superman assured Conner that he was a valued part of the Superman Family and that they would always be there for him. Soon after, they faced a villain called The Chained, who had been empowered and then imprisoned by Luthor. The Chained had similar telekinetic powers to Conner, though far greater. By pushing his abilities further than ever before, Conner was able to counteract the powers of the Chained and save Metropolis from his attack, along with saving Luthor and his daughter Lena. After this victory, Conner faces the future with renewed confidence in himself and his place in the world.

guide.overview: Conner Kent is a Supporter who boosts his own and an ally's **DMG output**, with a greater effect on **Superman Family** members. He also grants the ally limited **control immunity**.

legacyPieces.name: Super Six-String
legacyPieces.reason: Conner Kent's signature gear. Its universal skill increases Energy gain and grants a significant Attack bonus to allies. Its exclusive skill increases Effect Resistance, and at max level can freeze enemies at the start of battle, turning Conner into a powerful Supporter who excels at both damage boosting and control.

legacyPieces.name: Starheart Staff
legacyPieces.reason: Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when Conner Kent casts his Ultimate. Since his Ultimate boosts allies' Attack and grants control immunity, this staff makes [Superman Family] allies receive double Attack bonuses.

legacyPieces.name: Energy Mace
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Attack and Effect Accuracy. Conner Kent's skill reduces targets' Physical Defense, and the Effect Accuracy bonus ensures this crucial debuff lands. Works especially well with [Superman Family] allies for deadlier physical damage.

legacyPieces.name: Flash-Bulb Kite
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Energy gain. Conner Kent's Ultimate is the key source of bonuses for [Superman Family] allies, so faster Energy recovery means he can grant more Attack bonuses and control immunity to the squad.
